packaging_repair.reason: pyproject.toml declares no package-data, so the stock setuptools wheel/sdist omit runtime data files: storage.py reads migrations/001_initial.sql from the installed package dir. The unrepaired wheel installed but every DB init failed (FileNotFoundError); verify_release.py caught this. The build script injects the file into the wheel (RECORD updated) and sdist; contents unchanged. Demo fixtures (fixtures/demo/**) are injected into the sdist only: demo.py resolves them via Path(__file__).parents[2], which is the repo root in source but lib/python3.12 when installed -- a location no wheel layout can populate -- so the installed wheel's export-format / research-correction scenarios stay broken (see known_gaps.demo_fixtures_installed); the default j01 scenario needs no fixtures and passes installed.
packaging_repair.durable_fix_pending: Make demo.py load fixtures via importlib.resources (demo.py is core-owned). The migration SQL is no longer pending: pyproject.toml declares the package-data since the R4 rework (P2-R4-09), so a wheel rebuilt from the sdist alone now keeps it.
